description:
***LAST REMAINING APARTMENTS AVAILABLE TO VIEW***

Act quick and don't miss out on this great opportunity to rent a unique property at Occu East Village.

We are pleased to offer our last remaining 1 and 2 bedroom apartments and 3 bedroom duplexes in this brand-new development. 

Apartments at East Village are designed to support our residents' lifestyles, with modern finishes, open-plan layouts, and private outside space. Beautifully designed curated interiors with sleek and contemporary furnishings maximise space, ensuring a seamless flow between areas. 

Our Resident Experience Team is on hand in the Resident Amenity Space, which offers a Gym, Residents Lounge, Meeting room, Media room, and Kitchen. Occu's signature style of renting meets 14 acres of natural parkland at East Village. Sitting within Clay Farm, East Village is bordered by the neighbourhoods of Foxrock, Cabinteely, and Stepaside. 

Adventure-loving residents have immediate access to the tracks and trails of Clay Farm's vast parkland, while Dún Laoghaire and the Dublin mountains are just 15 minutes away. The city centre is within easy reach if you are commuting and for day-trippers via the Leopardstown Valley Luas stop and the M50. 

Properties at East Village offer the following:

-	Sleek and contemporary furnishings
-	Large private balconies
-	Modern bathrooms with shower and bath
-	Excellent appliances
-	Open-plan living spaces 
-	Dedicated parking space
-	Secure bicycle storage
-	Landscaped surrounds
-	Resident Amenity Space

At Occu, we believe that renting should be better. That's why we're working hard to bring you the best: smarter, benefit-focused, and centered around the needs of our residents. No uncertainty, no hidden costs, and stunning homes (and we'll let your pets move in too!). 

Please note: BER's range from A2-A3
